app.title: Bag configurator

errors.NOT_ON_STEP: Value must be a multiple of {{step}} mm

standardSize.label: Standard size
standardSize.info: Catalogue sizes for the selected handle (W × D × H). Changing any dimension makes it a custom size.
standardSize.unavailableInfo: Greyed-out sizes exceed the current configurator limits:
standardSize.none: There are no standard sizes for the selected handle — enter custom dimensions.

warnings.BOTTOM_TRAPEZOID_DEGENERATE: Width below {{minWidth}} mm (depth + 30 mm): the front and back bottom flaps form a triangle instead of a trapezoid and the bottom sides overlap. Check feasibility with production.

handle.label: Handle
handle.placementNote: Handles are glued to the inside of the front and back walls.

description.NONE: Classic block-bottom bag without a handle — the widest choice of papers and an optional moisture barrier.
description.FLAT_PAPER: Flat handle of strong, multi-folded kraft paper, glued inside and reinforced with a paper patch.
description.TWISTED_PAPER: Twisted handle of strong kraft paper, glued inside and reinforced with a paper patch.

adjusted.intro: The paper was adjusted to the selected handle:
adjusted.type: paper type: {{from}} → {{to}} (the previous one is not available with this handle)
adjusted.moistureBarrier: moisture barrier switched off (not available with this handle)

artwork.label: Artwork
artwork.choose: or click / press Enter to choose one
artwork.fillNote: Artwork is stretched over the whole panel.
artwork.aspectMismatch: The artwork's proportions ({{imageRatio}}) differ from the panel's ({{panelRatio}}) — the artwork will be distorted.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Unsupported file format. Allowed: PNG, JPG, WEBP.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (max. {{maxMb}} MB).
errors.DECODE_FAILED: The file could not be read as an image.

paper.label: Paper
paper.grammageRange: Range for the selected handle: {{min}}–{{max}} g/m², in steps of {{step}} g/m²

print.label: Print

errors.TOO_LONG: The code is too long (max. {{max}} characters).
errors.DUPLICATE: This colour is already on the list.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of {{max}} colours has been reached.

print.previewNote: The preview colour approximates the Pantone ink on screen (RGB) — used for previews and the ink-coverage estimate.
